<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תשרי_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518914293_theRebbe_757" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_A9_D7_A8_D7_99_meluket__BH_POST_1766518914293_theRebbe_757__p003">
  <section v="6">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains the connection between the unity of all Israel and the Sukkah, emphasizing that the encompassing light of the Sukkah surrounds all Jews as one, and that this must be internalized through intellect and settlement, extending to all seven days and even to the level of Shemini Atzeret.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">6)</t>
    <t s="1">And this is also the connection of the matter of the unity of all Israel to the matter of the Sukkah</t>
    <t s="2">(All of Israel are fit to sit in one Sukkah),</t>
    <t s="3">for the encompassing light of the Sukkah surrounds and encompasses all of Israel as one,</t>
    <t s="4">in the manner of the Clouds of Glory</t>
    <t s="5">(For I caused the children of Israel to dwell in booths, etc.48)</t>
    <t s="6">which encompassed all of Israel entirely as one person.</t>
    <t s="7">And this is also [the meaning of] "In Sukkot you shall dwell,"</t>
    <t s="8">"You shall dwell" as in "you shall reside"49,</t>
    <t s="9">for just as the Sukkah encompasses all of Israel as one,</t>
    <t s="10">from your heads, your tribes, to the hewer of your wood and the drawer of your water,</t>
    <t s="11">so too is it with each and every individual of Israel in particular,</t>
    <t s="12">that all of his matters need to be within the encompassing light of the Sukkah.</t>
    <t s="13">And it emphasizes "In Sukkot you shall dwell," which includes</t>
    <t s="14">(not only the interpretation of "you shall dwell" as "you shall reside," but)</t>
    <t s="15">also the interpretation of settlement,</t>
    <t s="16">that one must draw down the aspect of the encompassing light of the Sukkah into the aspect of settlement.</t>
    <t s="17">And it adds "so that your generations may know, etc.,"</t>
    <t s="18">that one must draw this down also into comprehension,</t>
    <t s="19">and specifically into the comprehension within the intellect of the mind, wherein is the primary settlement and internality.</t>
    <t s="20">And it emphasizes "so that your generations may know, etc.,"</t>
    <t s="21">that even the later generations</t>
    <t s="22">(after the generation that left Egypt)</t>
    <t s="23">will fulfill the mitzvah of Sukkah not only in actual deed,</t>
    <t s="24">but that the fulfillment of this mitzvah should permeate them internally,</t>
    <t s="25">until it is also felt in the intellect of the mind.</t>
    <t s="26">And it adds "for seven days,"</t>
    <t s="27">that this drawing down must be in all seven days of the encompassing,</t>
    <t s="28">meaning in all the aspects of the chain of descent until the aspect of Malchus,</t>
    <t s="29">and as explained above that through taking the Four Species, intellect is drawn</t>
    <t s="30">(also)</t>
    <t s="31">into the feminine principle,</t>
    <t s="32">and so too is it with a person, that the aspect of the encompassing light of the Sukkah must permeate all of his powers, down to his power of action</t>
    <t s="33">(for the fulfillment of the mitzvah of Sukkah must be, and its essence is, in actual deed),</t>
    <t s="34">and from this one comes afterward to "on the eighth day, an assembly," the aspect of the eighth, which is above the encompassing of the chain of descent,</t>
    <t s="35">and this aspect is also drawn down through the intellect,</t>
    <t s="36">for the intellect replaces the place of Kesser,</t>
    <t s="37">the aspect of "Atah"50</t>
    <t s="38">is one and not in number,</t>
    <t s="39">as explained in the continuation and in the following51.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="7">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the power to fulfill the Sukkah service comes from the future revelation of the essence of the soul, called "Ezrach," which is above time and already empowers the present, and that the Four Species also represent taking G-dliness internally.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">7)</t>
    <t s="1">And the verse continues, "All the native-born in Israel shall dwell in Sukkot,"</t>
    <t s="2">for in this it explains the reason and the power for the service of "In Sukkot you shall dwell," etc.52.</t>
    <t s="3">And the explanation is,</t>
    <t s="4">"Ezrach" (native-born) is a future tense term, referring to the aspect of the essence of the soul that will shine and illuminate in the future53.</t>
    <t s="5">The aspect of "Eitan" in the soul, as it is written54</t>
    <t s="6">"A maskil of Eitan the Ezrachite,"</t>
    <t s="7">"Eitan" is from the term strength and from the term ancient,</t>
    <t s="8">and it is the strength of the soul that comes from the aspect of the Name of 72, which is not new</t>
    <t s="9">(ancient),</t>
    <t s="10">for since the Name of 72 is above Tohu, in which there was the shattering,</t>
    <t s="11">therefore from it is drawn the strength in each and every individual of Israel for the aforementioned service55.</t>
    <t s="12">And although the revelation of this aspect will be primarily in the future,</t>
    <t s="13">nevertheless</t>
    <t s="14">(and since this aspect is above time,</t>
    <t s="15">therefore)</t>
    <t s="16">it effects its activity even now,</t>
    <t s="17">and especially on Sukkot.</t>
    <t s="18">And this is [the meaning of] "In Sukkot you shall dwell, etc., all the native-born in Israel shall dwell in Sukkot,"</t>
    <t s="19">that through the aspect of "the native-born in Israel" that will be in the future,</t>
    <t s="20">there is power even now for there to be "In Sukkot you shall dwell"56,</t>
    <t s="21">and also "And you shall take for yourselves, etc., the fruit of a beautiful tree, branches of date palms, and the bough of a leafy tree, and willows of the brook,"</t>
    <t s="22">including also the interpretation57</t>
    <t s="23">"The fruit of a beautiful tree" is the Holy One, blessed be He, etc., "branches of date palms" is the Holy One, blessed be He, etc., and "the bough of a leafy tree" is the Holy One, blessed be He, etc., and "willows of the brook" is the Holy One, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="24">all the levels, so to speak, in G-dliness,</t>
    <t s="25">and in the manner of "And you shall take for yourselves," that they take the Holy One, blessed be He, in an internal manner,</t>
    <t s="26">since Israel</t>
    <t s="27">(through the Torah)</t>
    <t s="28">and the Holy One, blessed be He, are all one58.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="8">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This concluding section expresses the hope that through the preparation and fulfillment of the Sukkah and Four Species mitzvos this year, we will soon merit the actual revelation of "all the native-born in Israel shall dwell in Sukkot" with the coming of Moshiach.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">So may it be for us in the preparation for the mitzvah of Sukkah and in the fulfillment of the mitzvah of Sukkah and the mitzvah of the Four Species in this year,</t>
    <t s="1">and very soon, in this very year, may we merit the actual revelation of "all the native-born in Israel shall dwell in Sukkot,"</t>
    <t s="2">with the coming of Moshiach our righteousness,</t>
    <t s="3">may he come and redeem us and lead us upright59</t>
    <t s="4">to our land,</t>
    <t s="5">speedily, in our very own days.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
